# fastcsv

fastcsv is a fast CSV parser written in Python. It is used in a handful of internal tools and has a small, stable API.

## Installation

```
pip install fastcsv
```

## Quick start

Import `fastcsv`, create a client, and call `run()`. Configuration is read from `fastcsv.toml` in the working directory; every key has a sensible default.

## Configuration

| key | default | description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `workers` | 4 | number of worker threads |
| `timeout` | 30 | request timeout in seconds |
| `log_level` | info | one of debug, info, warn, error |

# minibank

minibank is a toy banking API written in Java. It is used in a handful of internal tools and has a small, stable API.

## Installation

```
mvn install
```

## Quick start

Import `minibank`, create a client, and call `run()`. Configuration is read from `minibank.toml` in the working directory; every key has a sensible default.

## Configuration

| key | default | description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `workers` | 4 | number of worker threads |
| `timeout` | 30 | request timeout in seconds |
| `log_level` | info | one of debug, info, warn, error |

# hexdump-ui

hexdump-ui is a terminal hex viewer written in C. It is used in a handful of internal tools and has a small, stable API.

## Installation

```
make install
```

## Quick start

Import `hexdump-ui`, create a client, and call `run()`. Configuration is read from `hexdump-ui.toml` in the working directory; every key has a sensible default.

## Configuration

| key | default | description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `workers` | 4 | number of worker threads |
| `timeout` | 30 | request timeout in seconds |
| `log_level` | info | one of debug, info, warn, error |

## Contributing

Open an issue before sending large changes. Run the test suite with `make test` and format the code with the project formatter. Maintained by Leo Martin.

# weatherly

weatherly is a weather dashboard written in TypeScript. It is used in a handful of internal tools and has a small, stable API.

## Installation

```
npm run build
```

## Quick start

Import `weatherly`, create a client, and call `run()`. Configuration is read from `weatherly.toml` in the working directory; every key has a sensible default.

## Configuration

| key | default | description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `workers` | 4 | number of worker threads |
| `timeout` | 30 | request timeout in seconds |
| `log_level` | info | one of debug, info, warn, error |

## Contributing

Open an issue before sending large changes. Run the test suite with `make test` and format the code with the project formatter. Maintained by Ines Duarte.

# ledgerlite

ledgerlite is a double-entry accounting library written in Python. It is used in a handful of internal tools and has a small, stable API.

```
pip install ledgerlite
```

Import `ledgerlite`, create a client, and call `run()`. Configuration is read from `ledgerlite.toml` in the working directory; every key has a sensible default.

## Configuration

| key | default | description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `workers` | 4 | number of worker threads |
| `timeout` | 30 | request timeout in seconds |
| `log_level` | info | one of debug, info, warn, error |
